title: Client samples
purpose: Track your received samples and open issued reports containing their results.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Only an active signed-in account linked to a client can use these pages. Every project, sample, report and download is limited to that client. Other clients’ records are treated as missing. Internal staff and unrelated accounts cannot use the portal. These reporting views are read-only; drafts never appear here.
When Demonstration appears, all clients, samples and results are synthetic and must not be used as laboratory results or for regulatory or compliance purposes.
The portal’s top navigation marks the current area. No staff work queue or result-edit controls are available here.

items.label: Home
items.description: Client overview, recent reports and live sample-status counts.

items.label: Projects
items.description: Client projects with sample/report counts.

items.label: Quotes
items.description: Open the separate client quote workflow.

items.label: Submissions
items.description: Open the separate client pre-login/submission workflow.

items.label: Samples
items.description: Live status of the client’s received samples.

items.label: Reports
items.description: Issued reports and stored downloads.

sections.title: Filters and defaults
paragraphs: Default order is most recently collected first.

items.label: Search
items.description: Case-insensitive client sample ID or lab ID search only; it does not search location, analyte or result values.

items.label: Project
items.description: All projects by default; choices contain only this client’s projects.

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status by default, or one of the six computed live states below. A status link from Home arrives with this filter set.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Reveal Collected from and Collected to; opens when a value or filter error is present.

items.label: Collected from / Collected to
items.description: Inclusive local collection-date bounds; collection end is used for composite samples. Invalid dates/status/project choices show errors and no rows, never a wider client search.

items.label: Your sample ID
items.description: Client’s sample identifier; fixed visible. This is not a link to a separate sample-detail page.

items.label: Lab ID
items.description: Unique laboratory sample identity for communication with staff.

items.label: Project
items.description: Owning client project.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Water, Wastewater or Soil sample matrix; hidden initially.

items.label: Location
items.description: Recorded collection location or Not recorded; hidden initially. This is descriptive collection text, not an EDD site-location mapping.

items.label: Collected
items.description: Collection instant or composite end, displayed in laboratory local time. Hover shows timezone.

items.label: Received
items.description: Laboratory receipt time; hidden initially. Hover shows timezone.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Number of requested tests on this sample, not number approved/reported; hidden initially.

items.label: Status
items.description: Current computed progress or receipt restriction; see the rules below. Sorting follows the underlying status-code order rather than workflow-progress order.

items.label: Report
items.description: Link to the report with the most recently released version containing any internal or external result revision of this sample. A link can remain even when current work is no longer fully reported. Open the report’s current version/history to see what it covers; a dash means no owned issued version links to a result yet.

sections.title: How live sample status is determined
paragraphs: Status reflects current data. New requested tests, corrections or replacement external sources can move a sample out of Reported while older issued PDFs remain unchanged and downloadable. The count/status does not guarantee a delivery date or recipient acceptance.

items.label: Rejected at receipt
items.description: Receipt disposition is Reject; this takes precedence over all analytical/report states.

items.label: On hold
items.description: Receipt disposition is Hold, unless rejected. Contact the laboratory about the hold.

items.label: Reported
items.description: At least one requested test and every current approved internal revision or latest accepted active external source appears in an issued report owned by this client. Merely having an older issued result is insufficient.

items.label: Report in preparation
items.description: At least one test and all tests currently approved internally or accepted from active external sources, but not all current revisions appear in issued reports. This is computed from test progress, not proof that a report draft exists or passes release checks.

items.label: In analysis
items.description: At least one internal result revision has been entered or an active subcontract exists, and the higher-priority states do not apply. An assigned internal batch without an entered result can still be Received.

items.label: Received
items.description: Default when the earlier conditions do not apply, including no requested tests or no entered work.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply combined search and filters to all matching records and return to page 1.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search, filters and query-based sorting/page settings. An active-filter chip removes only that filter and returns to page 1.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort ascending or descending across the full filtered set. Unlinked headings cannot sort. Equal values use record ID as a tie-breaker; unsupported sorts fall back to the page default.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100, default 25. Changing this returns to page 1 and preserves other filters. Show applies the choice when automatic submission is unavailable. Other sizes are refused.

items.label: First page / Previous page / Next page / Last page
items.description: Move through matching records while preserving filters and sort. The footer shows visible range, total, current page and page count. Invalid page text selects page 1; out-of-range pages select the last page.

items.label: Columns
items.description: With browser enhancement, change optional column visibility and order using the dialog’s move controls or by dragging headings. Changes apply immediately and are saved in this browser only. Locked identity/action columns stay visible and fixed. Reset columns restores defaults; Done or Close closes the dialog. Presentation settings do not change records, filters or exports.

sections.title: Empty and error states
paragraphs: No samples received yet means no lab receipt records exist for your client, including planned-only submissions. No matches suggests checking the ID or clearing filters. Invalid filters retain errors for correction and never expose another client’s data.
